title: Auditing Invisible Weight Updates with Reference Traces
abstract: arXiv:2607.09800v4 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Direct low-precision write-back can erase nonzero optimizer proposals. We ask what a high-precision reference trace establishes before a low-precision run. The exact target-code event is auditable coordinatewise on a realized target trajectory; pre-run aggregate projection also assumes the reference remains a useful counterfactual. In a controlled two-layer grid, 55/72 cells have measured and predicted post-initialization crossings: times span $384\times$, 52/55 are within 15\%, and 4/72 differ in category. Matched decoder experiments show stochastic rather than nearest write-back recovers most of the loss gap. A prospective analytic-grid E4M3 audit reuses one fp32 trace across three unseen NeoX-style seeds. It passes absolute-accuracy and skill gates (macro RMSE 0.00858) but fails directional specificity. In a target-outcome-blind comparison, a historical template has lower descriptive RMSE (0.00360) than the predeclared source pred

translated_title: 通过参考轨迹审计不可见的权重更新
translated_abstract: arXiv:2607.09800v4 公告类型：替换。摘要：直接的低精度写回可能会抹除非零优化器提议。我们探讨高精度参考轨迹在低精度运行之前确立了什么。精确的目标代码事件在实现的目标轨迹上可逐坐标审计；运行前的聚合投影也假设参考轨迹仍然是一个有用的反事实。在一个受控的两层网格中，55/72个单元具有测量和预测的初始化后交叉点：时间跨度达384倍，其中52/55在15%以内，4/72在类别上存在差异。匹配的解码器实验表明，随机而非最近的写回恢复了大部分损失差距。一个前瞻性的解析网格E4M3审计在三个未见过的NeoX风格种子中重用了一个fp32轨迹。它通过了绝对精度和技能门限（宏观RMSE 0.00858），但在方向特异性上失败。在目标结果盲比较中，历史模板的描述性RMSE（0.00360）低于预先声明的来源预测。
tldr: 本研究提出通过高精度参考轨迹对低精度权重更新进行审计，发现随机写回优于最近写回，且该方法在绝对精度上有效但在方向特异性上存在局限。
en_tdlr: This study proposes auditing low-precision weight updates using high-precision reference traces, finding stochastic write-back outperforms nearest write-back, with the method passing absolute accuracy but failing directional specificity.
